results.question: how many things can i pick up at west village, broken down by category?

       COUNT(*) AS item_count
FROM nlq.listings l

GROUP BY l.category
ORDER BY l.category;
results.answer: At West Village, you can pick up 17 bikes_transport, 24 clothing, 37 dorm_essentials, 57 electronics, 41 furniture, 34 kitchen, 11 other, 22 sports_outdoors, and 53 textbooks. These figures cover all time.

results.question: average agreed price of completed bike sales in 2025
results.sql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.agreed_price)::numeric, 2) AS avg_agreed_price
FROM nlq.deals d
JOIN nlq.listings_all l ON d.item_id = l.item_id
WHERE d.deal_type = 'sale'
  AND d.status = 'completed'
  AND l.category = 'bikes_transport'
  AND d.completed_on >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND d.completed_on <= DATE '2025-12-31';
results.answer: The average agreed price of completed bike sales in 2025 was $184.51.

results.question: which meetup spot got the most new listings in spring 2026?
results.sql:
SELECT ms.name AS meetup_spot, COUNT(*) AS new_listings
FROM nlq.listings_all la
JOIN nlq.calendar c ON la.listed_on = c.day
JOIN nlq.meetup_spots ms ON la.spot_id = ms.spot_id
WHERE c.semester = 'Spring'
  AND c.academic_year = '2025-26'
  AND la.status = 'available'
GROUP BY ms.name
ORDER BY new_listings DESC
LIMIT 1;
results.answer: Snell Library had the most new listings in Spring 2026, with 60 listings.

results.question: what share of all listings ever posted were offered for rent?
results.sql:
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_listings,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_for_rent THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rent_listings,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_for_rent THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 2) AS rent_share_percent
FROM nlq.listings_all;
results.answer: 24.96% of all listings ever posted were offered for rent, which is 3,231 out of 12,947 listings.

results.question: for each category, how many days on average does it take an item to sell?
results.sql:
SELECT la.category,
       round(avg(extract(epoch from d.completed_at - la.listed_at) / 86400)::numeric, 2) AS avg_days_to_sell
FROM nlq.deals d
JOIN nlq.listings_all la ON d.item_id = la.item_id
WHERE d.deal_type = 'sale'
  AND d.status = 'completed'
  AND la.is_for_sale = true
GROUP BY la.category
ORDER BY avg_days_to_sell DESC;
results.answer: Across all categories, the average time from listing to sale ranges from 11.20 to 12.08 days. The fastest-selling categories are bikes_transport (11.20 days) and furniture (11.61 days), while the longest average is other (12.08 days).

results.question: what share of conversations led to a request, by meetup spot?
results.sql:
SELECT ms.name AS meetup_spot,
       COUNT(*) AS total_conversations,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.led_to_request THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS led_to_request_count,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.led_to_request THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 2) AS share_percent
FROM nlq.conversations c
JOIN nlq.listings_all la ON c.item_id = la.item_id
JOIN nlq.meetup_spots ms ON la.spot_id = ms.spot_id
GROUP BY ms.name
ORDER BY ms.name;
results.answer: Across all time, conversations at each meetup spot had the following shares that led to a request: Curry Student Center 61.45%, Fenway (off campus) 62.91%, International Village 63.00%, Marino Recreation Center 63.61%, Mission Hill (off campus) 62.41%, Snell Library 62.30%, and West Village 63.55%.

results.question: late-return rate for rentals due during finals compared with rentals due during regular classes
results.sql:
SELECT
  c.period AS period,
  ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN d.returned_late THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 2) AS late_return_rate_percent
FROM nlq.deals d
JOIN nlq.calendar c ON d.rental_due_date = c.day
WHERE d.deal_type = 'rental'
  AND d.rental_returned_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.period
ORDER BY c.period;
results.answer: The late-return rate for rentals due during finals is 18.66%, compared with 19.66% for rentals due during regular classes. These figures cover all time.

results.question: which category has the highest sell-through rate?
results.sql:
SELECT la.category,
       COUNT(*) AS total_listings,
       SUM(CASE WHEN d.deal_type = 'sale' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sold_count,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.deal_type = 'sale' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 2) AS sell_through_percent
FROM nlq.listings_all la
JOIN nlq.deals d ON la.item_id = d.item_id
GROUP BY la.category
ORDER BY sell_through_percent DESC
LIMIT 1;
